title: The Dinosaur Has 24 Hours to Save the World

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Earth has twenty four hours. Our only hope is him.

scenes.speaker: Max
scenes.line: The dinosaur? He lost a fight with a grape.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: He needs to press the giant red button!

scenes.speaker: Max
scenes.line: Easy. Put a snack on it.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Why is the asteroid turning around?

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: That was its remote control. He is flying it.

scenes.speaker: Max
scenes.line: He is parking it in our driveway!

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Do we teach him to steer, or bribe him with grapes?

description: The Dinosaur Has 24 Hours to Save the World. A  DRIVING LESSON or B  GRAPE BRIBE? Tell us your choice in the comments. Fictional animated comedy. #AIHOUSE #Shorts #AnimatedComedy
